purpose: Source arithmetic recreation and explicit final-BFO compatibility of saved aircraft states
status: conditional diagnostic, no geographic posterior or calibrated likelihood
error_sign_note: Section III-A defines prediction-minus-observation errors [-28,+18] Hz; Tables III/V instead extend the adjusted observation by [-18,+28]. Both are retained as separate conventions.

conditions.observed_bfo_locator: PDF page 9, Tables III and V
conditions.error_locator: PDF page 2, section III-A: extrema of 2,501 retained BFO errors from 20 preceding flights, used as assumed strict bounds in this paper
conditions.warmup_locator: PDF page 7, section V-A final paragraphs and V-B; seven preceding log-ons, with closed-loop compensation adjustment for six ground log-ons
conditions.no_warmup_locator: PDF page 8, section VI-B; Tables V and VI
limitations: Historical error extrema are not a calibrated probability distribution or a guaranteed physical bound on a new observation.
The previous sustained outages do not calibrate a one-minute power interruption; the paper explicitly notes this limitation.
The two warmup offsets share one event and are constrained by their drop; independent extreme combinations are not allowed.
Conditional calculations assume no additional unknown factor corrupts the two observations.
The comparison uses the stored R600 checkpoint at 00:19:29.416 and the nominal rounded R1200 checkpoint at 00:19:37.000. It does not infer a precise acceleration from those times.

bias_note: Uses each source path’s posterior mean steady BFO bias from observations through00:11. Shared bias is constant across the final pair and cancels from its difference; it is not re-fitted to the final observations.
